## Feminiq Rides MCP Server

The official remote MCP server of Feminiq Rides, a chauffeur service in Amsterdam run by a female executive chauffeur. Agents can list Schiphol routes, private tours and vehicles with prices (list_services), get an exact signed price quote (get_quote), and send a ride request (request_booking). Requests are confirmed by the customer by email, then confirmed personally by the business; nothing is charged through MCP. No authentication is needed.
